description: The figure is a pie-style chart representing four criteria or dimensions associated with the referenced paper/benchmark, displayed as an evenly divided circle with four slices. There are 4 categories: “Complexity” shown in a yellow slice occupying about one quarter of the circle, “Instance” shown in a light blue slice occupying about one quarter, “Coverage” shown in a light green slice occupying about one quarter, and “Scalable Oversight” shown in a red slice occupying about one quarter. Each slice contains its label and a small black icon, and the slices are separated by white cross-shaped dividers; no numeric percentage labels are printed inside the slices. Around the pie are additional rounded text boxes that appear to correspond to the quadrants, including “Unhackable” near the blue quadrant, “General” near the green quadrant, and “Auto-verifiable” near the red quadrant, plus a small unlabeled/blurred box near the yellow quadrant; there is no conventional legend, and no slice is exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the equal partitioning.
